name: coach-di
description: Coach Di web application and Capacitor Android app

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-coach-di-refunds --config firebase.emulator.json "node --test test-rules/*.test.cjs"
scripts.test:auth: node scripts/prepare-auth-tests.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-coach-di-session --config firebase.auth-emulator.json "playwright test --config playwright.auth.config.js"
